headline: Sensex tanks 1,000 points and Nifty hits 52-week low as RBI hike and oil prices weigh on markets

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty hit their lowest levels in 1.5 years
Nifty reached a fresh 52-week low as Sensex tanked over 1,000 points
GST Council allowed ITC refunds on capital goods and services in a major reform
Auto stocks like M&M and Maruti Suzuki hit 52-week lows after slipping 12% in a month
summary:
Indian markets plunged to 1.5-year lows as an RBI rate hike and surging crude oil prices triggered a massive selloff.
The Nifty hit a fresh 52-week low while major auto stocks like M&M and Maruti Suzuki reached yearly bottoms.
Global pressures, including rising US bond yields and declining futures, further dampened investor sentiment across the board.
